_meta.purpose: Indicative premium ranges (term plans) and indicative benefits per premium (savings plans), built from the worked examples printed in each official brochure. Used by the premium tools; the LLM never computes prices itself.
_meta.source: Brochure illustrations (page numbers per anchor). Premiums exclude taxes; individual life policies are GST-exempt w.e.f. 22 Sep 2025 per the SBI brochures.
_meta.status: INDICATIVE. Anchors are exact brochure figures; everything in 'model' is a labelled assumption, not insurer rates.
_meta.spoken_disclaimer_en: This is an indicative range based on the insurer's own brochure examples, not a quote. The final premium is set by the insurer after underwriting.
_meta.spoken_disclaimer_hi: Ye sirf ek andaaza hai, insurer ke brochure ke examples ke basis par. Final premium insurer underwriting ke baad hi batayega.

term_model.method: est = anchor_premium x (SA / anchor_SA) x exp(age_k x (age - anchor_age)) x tobacco_factor x gender_factor; range = [est x range_low, est x range_high], rounded to nearest 500. Use the product's anchor closest in age with the same pay type; quote regular pay only (limited/single pay -> advisor).
term_model.age_k_note: ASSUMPTION: ~7% higher premium per year of entry age, typical of Indian term pricing; not from brochures.
term_model.tobacco_note: ASSUMPTION: tobacco users typically pay ~50-80% more; brochures only say non-tobacco users get special rates.
term_model.gender_note: Use the product's stated female discount where the brochure gives one; otherwise ASSUMPTION 0.85.
term_model.anchor_sa_note: Anchors at 1 Cr are preferred; scaling far from the anchor SA (e.g. 25 lakh) adds error, so widen to [0.75, 1.35] below 50 lakh.

sbi-smart-shield-plus.gender_note: Brochure: 'lower rates for women' (no % stated) -> use default 0.85

notes: Return of premium: 100% of premiums paid comes back at maturity (p3-4, e.g. Rs 6,68,520 on Rs 22,284 x 30)
tobacco status not stated in the brochure examples
Both anchors are the Life Plus variant (adds accidental death cover); the plain Life variant should cost somewhat less - say so.

savings_model.method: Scale the illustration benefit linearly with the customer's chosen annual premium (benefit x premium / illustration premium). Always say the illustration age and that the actual figure depends on age, term and option. For participating plans, always give both 4% and 8% and say bonuses are not guaranteed.
savings_model.note: ASSUMPTION: linear scaling ignores age and high-premium enhancements; fine for an indicative conversation.
